question: Does the sealed B checkpoint materially use the semantic content of role-free presentation evidence, and which current evidence families contribute to positive or negative transfer across FIT8?

interventions.B_VALUE_ZERO_KEEP_VALID: Zero semantic value channels while preserving their validity bits, token count, top-level mask, kind, structural anchors, and camera. This intentionally creates typed zero-valued evidence rather than abstention.
interventions.B_SEMANTICS_ABSTAIN: Zero each semantic value together with its paired validity bit while preserving token count, top-level mask, kind, xyz_a/xyz_b, xyz_b_valid, camera, and camera_valid. This leaves presentation-token geometry/layout but removes admitted semantic evidence.
interventions.B_SEMANTICS_SHUFFLED_WITHIN_KIND: Deterministically permute semantic value+validity bundles among tokens of the same kind while structural anchors, camera, kind, token count, and top-level mask remain fixed. The permutation is seeded per subject and is required to change at least one semantic-bearing token when possible.
interventions.B_MINUS_FRONT: Set front_probability and front_valid to zero only.
interventions.B_MINUS_VISIBILITY: Set global_visibility and global_visibility_valid to zero only.
interventions.B_MINUS_RGBA_SUPPORT: Set source_rgba/source_rgba_valid and source_support/source_support_valid to zero.

interpretation.content_materially_used: B_SEMANTICS_ABSTAIN and/or B_SEMANTICS_SHUFFLED_WITHIN_KIND materially erase correct-B gains on the B-winning subjects, showing frozen-model dependence on evidence content/alignment rather than presentation-branch presence alone.
interpretation.content_utilization_weak: Semantic abstention and shuffling preserve nearly all correct-B gains, suggesting the current benefit is dominated by presentation-token geometry/layout, branch conditioning, or training/regularization effects rather than semantic evidence content.
interpretation.channel_attribution: Single-family ablations are interpreted only as frozen-model behavioral dependence; interactions between channels are allowed and additive importance is not assumed.
interpretation.negative_transfer: Horse/GreenBlob rescue under an ablation identifies a candidate harmful evidence family or interaction but does not establish corpus-level causality.
